entertainmentProgram: Denser and later, built around a designed flow: the Ginger lobby bar carries live Caribbean dance music all evening, the Olympus Theater runs a different produced show nearly every night, and the Red Lounge picks up when the theater empties. A daytime thread Cancún lacks: live sets by the adult pool and a midday dance lesson that connects day to night. Weekly Plaza Colonial party.
dayNightFlow: Daytime live sets + a midday dance lesson; dense evening flow theater->lounge; weekly Plaza Colonial party (sometimes clashes with the nightly theater show).
